paite: Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz in adawng a, hichi in achi:
heading: Houlim Nihveina / (Job 15.1-21.34) / Eliphaz thugen nihveina
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

paite: "Mipil in theihna bangmah lou toh dawnna abawl in, suahlam huih in agilpi adimsak diam?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

paite: Houlimna phatuam lou thu angaihtuah in, ahihkeileh hoih ahihtheihlouhna ding a thugente angaihtuah diam?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

paite: Ahi, launa na hihmang a, Pathian ma a kipiakzohna na dal lai hi.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

paite: Na kam in na thulimlouhna asinsak a, khemhatmi lei na tel ngal a.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

paite: Nang mahmah kam in siam louh ahon tangsak a, kei hilou in; ahi, nang dem in nangmah mukte mah in hon theihpih hi.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

paite: "Mihing piang masapen hi hia? Ahihkeileh mualte om ma a lakkhiak na hi maw?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

paite: Pathian thuguk na zata hia? Huan pilna na kikoih hoih hia?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

paite: Ka theih louh uh bang na thei a? kou a om lou bang na theisiam a?
english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

paite: Ka lak uah samkang leh upa mahmah a-om tuaktuak, na pa sang a nakpi a upazaw.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

paite: "Pathian nepnate leh siamtak a hon hilhte nang a dia neu lua uhia?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

paite: Bangziak a na lungtang in nang hon pimang ahia? Bangziak a na mitte phia ahia?
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

paite: Huchi a Pathian dem a na lungsim na hei a, na kam a pan a huai thute na pawtkhiaksak.
english: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

paite: "Mihing bang ahia, asian ding? Numei a pan piang amah kua ahia diktat ding?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

paite: Ngai in, amisiangthoute ah muanna anga kei a; amitmuh in vante asiang kei uhi.
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

paite: Mikihhuai leh sia, tui bang a thulimlouhna dawnmi, siang kei sem na in chia.
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

paite: "K'on ensak ding, hon za in; huan ka muhsa ka puang ding.
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

paite: Mipil kuate in ahia apipute ua kipan na thu gen a, a-iim louh uh.
english: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

paite: Amau kiang kia ah gam piak in a-om a, mikhual kuamah alak uah apai kei uh.
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

paite: "Migilou in adamsung niteng in natna athuak a, nuaisiah hatmi a dia kholkhawm kumte zah mah.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

paite: Abil ah launa ging a-om a; hauh lai in lokmi atung ah ahong pai ding hi.
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

paite: Khomial a kipan ahong kik ding chih a-um kei a, namsau a ngak in a-om hi.
english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

paite: Tanghou zong in avakvai a, Koi a om ahia? chi in. Khomial ni akiangchin ah mansa in a-om chih athei hi.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

paite: Dahna leh haksatna in amah alausak a; kumpipa galdou dia mansa bang in, amah azou uhi.
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

paite: "Pathian dou ding a khut alikkhiak ziak in, Bangkim hihthei dou a kisatheitak in,
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

paite: alum, atuamna sahtak nei toh amah dou a atai teitei ziak in;
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

paite: athau in amaitang akhuh a, agil ah thau akholkhawm hi.
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

paite: "Khopi tulsa ah ateng a, kuamah ten tuaklouhna innte ah, segawp ngiingei dingte aluah ziak in.
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

paite: Ahau kei ding a, aneih-le-lam a-om gige kei ding a; amah lei ah zung akai kei ding.
english: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

paite: Khomial a kipan asuakta kei ding a, meikuang in aselnoute akangkeu ding a, apaklun laite amutmang ding.
english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

paite: Amah kikhem in, bangmah lou ah muang kei hen: bangmah lou lah athukna hi ding ahi ngal a.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

paite: "Ahun ma in hihzoh in a-om dia, huan ahiang nou kei ding hi.
english: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

paite: Grepgui bang in agah min lou asingpulh dia, olive bang in apak apaikhe ding.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

paite: Pathian limsak lou kithuahkhawmna hut ding ahi a, golhna puaninte lah mei in akangmang ding hi.
english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

paite: Siatna apai ua, thulimlouhna asuakkhesak uh, alungtang un khemna a- nopkeuh uhi.
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
